verdict.rationale: EFTPS publishes an exact non-web fallback: a voice response system at 1.800.555.3453 that can be used interchangeably with the website to complete payments. It also points users to ACH Credit or same-day wire through their bank when needed. The documented fallback is telephone-based rather than the paper, fax, or mail rail the story asks for, so it covers only part of the story. Missing for 10: a published paper/mail payment address, a fax number, the specific paper forms (e.g., vouchers) for offline payment, and independent corroboration that the phone fallback works when the web flow is down.
